Hi @dkc42

Community members in the desktop forum can offer greater platform specific support. This forum is focused on the TB mobile app.

A similar question was answered in the desktop forum, and suggests the issue is a bug. https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/questions/1611065

This is a known bug. It will be fixed in TB158.0 to be released next week. https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2077526 Beyond drag and drop there is another workaround: at the top right of the Thunderbird window, click the menu button ≡ > Settings > General scroll down to the bottom and click 'Config Editor' search for the preference mail.compose.attach.dir the value (Path) here must be changed to one that is still available (for example C:) restart Thunderbird That should fix it.
